findings.title: Moderate analyzability score
findings.description: Only 79% of skill content could be analyzed. 1 of 6 files are opaque to the scanner. Some content could not be verified as safe.
findings.remediation: Review opaque files and replace with inspectable formats where possible.

findings.title: Skill does not specify a license
findings.description: Skill manifest does not include a 'license' field. Specifying a license helps users understand usage terms.
findings.remediation: Add 'license' field to SKILL.md frontmatter (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0)

findings.title: Archive file detected in skill package
findings.description: Archive file found: resources/templates.docx. Archives can contain hidden executables, scripts, or other malicious content that is not visible without extraction.
findings.remediation: Extract archive contents and include files directly, or document the archive's purpose.

findings.title: File extension does not match actual content type
findings.description: File 'templates.docx' extension (.docx, expected archive) does not match its actual content type (Microsoft Word 2007+ document, document).
findings.remediation: Rename the file to match its actual content type, or remove it if it appears malicious.

findings.title: Unanalyzable binary file
findings.description: Binary file 'resources/templates.docx' cannot be inspected by the scanner. Reason: Binary file (.docx) - cannot inspect content. Binary files resist static analysis and may contain hidden functionality.
findings.remediation: Replace binary files with source code, or submit the binary to VirusTotal for independent verification (--use-virustotal).

findings.title: Archive contains executable script
findings.description: Executable script 'resources/templates.docx!/sync1.sh' was extracted from archive 'resources/templates.docx'. Archives can be used to conceal malicious scripts from casual inspection.
findings.remediation: Remove executable scripts from archives. Include scripts directly in the skill package for transparency.
